prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE exceptional high-fidelity long desktop webpage design image for 8x Social, a creator network company. This is a continuous document-scroll composition, not a storyboard, presentation, collage of screenshots or a new hero. Portrait output approximately 1536 x 2048, showing one desktop page about 1.5 screens tall. Strong, minimal, quietly ambitious art direction; contemporary Swiss web typography, huge clean negative space, precise alignment, flat surfaces, original editorial restraint.
Reference 1: current website screenshot. Keep the brand's type character and stone palette but REMOVE all divider lines, bars, the black navigation strip, repeated CTAs and boxed layout. Reference 2: Maggie, the actual creator photo: preserve this real face/likeness, use ONCE as monochrome video still; do not invent a new model. Reference 3: the original dot world map, use its recognizable map silhouette, small round dots and geographic arrangement as the map reference. Do not reproduce its old UI furniture, rules, numbers or microcopy.
Design a CONTINUOUS STONE PAGE connecting the approved creator passage to the upcoming map. Background uniform warm stone #e9e5dc across the ENTIRE image. Black #111 typography, sparse orange #f34b32 accents. The final orange map background will be achieved by a shared page-background change on scroll in implementation; this image is the early approach state, so DO NOT draw orange panels or gradients. Show continuity by overlapping the vertical reading rhythm and leaving no discernible section boundary.
At the very top, a quiet inline original serif '8x social' mark at left, small links 'The network', 'How it works', 'For creators' and 'Let’s talk ↗' on right, all unboxed black on the same stone. No horizontal rule.
Upper roughly 45%: left aligned large but not hero-size headline 'Real voices.\nWider reach.' with an orange final dot, one small supporting line 'Creator content for the places people watch.' Below, restrained small black TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts platform marks with NO boxes. To the right, Maggie's monochrome creator video portrait, fairly large but with abundant surrounding stone. Image edges dissolve delicately into a precise fine round halftone grid, disappearing completely into the stone with no rectangular border. Her face is naturally realistic, not beautified. Portrait sits slightly higher than the text, making the layout feel editorial rather than two equal-column modules.
Middle flowing into lower 55%: the page continues naturally. Offset the next headline modestly to the left, following the same left gutter: 'One brief.\nMany markets.' in beautiful black sans serif, slightly smaller than the headline above. One short supporting sentence to its right 'Local creators. One team to bring it together.' and simple text link 'Plan your markets ↗'. No cards, no separators, no section labels, no eyebrow text.
An expansive, visually accurate BLACK DOT WORLD MAP appears beneath and gently alongside this text, occupying most of the lower width with Europe and Africa clearly readable. Use the supplied reference for geometry; densely enough spaced round dots to be recognizable but not heavy, selected regions black and rest muted stone-gray, one very restrained orange cluster around Europe. Fine portrait-edge dots above and map dots below share an obvious print language, but absolutely NO invented swirls, connecting lines, trails, particle ribbons, swooshes or decorative bridges. The relationship is through common material and alignment. The map has no card or rectangular container and sits directly on the same page. Show a tiny plain 'Explore a market' text control below it, no ruled row.
This should look like a beautifully typeset real website screenshot, with text and media within the SAME continuous canvas. The key is disciplined composition and legibility, not decorative effects. No fake stats, testimonials, charts, service cards, 3D ornaments, shadows, borders, ornamental rules, full-width bars, outer browser chrome, animation labels or explanatory annotations. No repeated hero portraits. Do not paste the reference screenshot; genuinely design the continuous composition.
